inlines.v: LIQ'UOR, noun lik'or [Latin liquor ] A liquid or fluid substance. [See Liquid.] liquor is a word of general signification, extending to water, milk, blood, say, juice, etc.; but its most common application is to spirituous fluids, whether distilled or fermented, to decoctions, solutions, tinctures. LIQ'UOR, verb transitive To moisten; to drench. [Little used.]
